visible_cues: short dark bob with wispy fringe

pixel_expectations.expectation: Black gloves worn on both forearms show smooth glossy latex reflections, not merely satin cloth or bare-skin highlights.
pixel_expectations.minimum_visible_evidence: Both glove surfaces and continuous highlights are distinguishable.

pixel_expectations.expectation: Both black gloves extend past the elbows onto the upper arms; glove tops remain visible in frame.
pixel_expectations.minimum_visible_evidence: Two elbows and at least one complete above-elbow glove top are readable; occlusion of the other must be reported.

pixel_expectations.expectation: A black choker encircles the performer neck and carries one conspicuous silver circular O-ring at its front.
pixel_expectations.minimum_visible_evidence: Black neck band and silver ring are separable from necklace/brooch/reflection.

pixel_expectations.expectation: The performer presents the brooch in open upward-facing hands toward the receiving colleague; the gesture reads as an offered object.
pixel_expectations.minimum_visible_evidence: Palms, brooch and target-directed receiving hand belong to the same exchange.

pixel_expectations.expectation: Warm candles illuminate one side while a cooler blue night-window light falls across the other side and room; source direction and light-temperature separation are visible.
pixel_expectations.minimum_visible_evidence: At least one warm candle source and a cool window-lit region are present.

pixel_expectations.expectation: The main performer retains the supplied portrait visible facial proportions and dark bob with wispy fringe.
pixel_expectations.minimum_visible_evidence: Face is large enough to compare eyes, outline, lips and fringe; similarity is qualitative, not identity verification.

pixel_expectations.expectation: The object exchange and receiving colleague reaction provide a readable thank-you pause within a working theatrical dressing room.
pixel_expectations.minimum_visible_evidence: Present action is understandable without unseen backstory; an unseen loan history must not be claimed as pixel proof.

authority_note: These tests do not promote the exact garment, ring, brooch, role, action, setting or lighting into requester-owned locks. Post-core compatible candidates may refine agent choices; any resulting test departures are reported.
